verdict.rationale: OpenHands has no native bulk-operation feature, but you can script work across many items yourself. The SDK can run multiple agent tasks in parallel with `asyncio.gather()`, the API supports automation and scripting, and scheduled or webhook-triggered automations (such as PR triage) can act on many items. Missing for 10: a native bulk-operation UI or command, documented batch semantics across many items (e.g., bulk-editing many repos, issues or PRs in one action), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
